title: Declaration-driven ordered matching
requirement: WHEN the generic ADT extension elaborates an admitted closed nominal declaration group, it SHALL produce TypeDecl/CtorLayout/MatchPlan mappings preserving the first matching source arm.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: New recursive Schedule declaration
scenarios.when: Schedule = Done | Pay(UInt128,Schedule) | Both(Schedule,Schedule) is matched by ordered arms Both(Pay(x,_),_)→x; Both(_,r)→sum(r); Pay(x,t)→x+sum(t); Done→0 on Both(Pay(4,Done),Pay(5,Done)).
scenarios.then: The selected arm is source arm one and the result is 4; a separate structural sum is 9. Nominal/constructor identity, source field order, binder occurrence paths and workMap are retained independently of compact tags or arena indices. Closed monomorphic mutually recursive groups are the initial extension; parameterized specialization needs its own finite bound, and closures/GADTs/or-patterns remain outside this adapter. Existing dedicated list/tree forms do not count as this extension's implementation.

expected.selected arm: source arm one (arm two would give 5)

unasserted: nominal/constructor identity, source field order and binder occurrence paths independent of compact tags

checks.label: ordered arms select arm one
